cases.question: What was the target range for the fed funds rate in February 2018?
cases.answer: In February 2018, the target range for the federal funds rate was 1.5% to 1.75%. This was the range decided upon at the December 2017 FOMC meeting, as indicated in the minutes released on February 21, 2018. The top of the range was 1.5%, and the bottom was 1.25%.

cases.question: What was the target range for the fed funds rate in February 2023?
cases.answer: The target range for the federal funds rate was raised to 4-1/2 to 4-3/4 percent at the meeting that ended on 2023-02-01. This decision was made unanimously (12 for, 0 against) and was documented in the minutes released on 2023-02-22. [cite: 2023-02-01/policyAction/2]
